objective: Calibrate the autonomous invention evaluation pipeline against 20 known cases using the REAL evidence-conditioned loop (search -> evidence -> claim mapping -> 102 -> 103 -> final adjudication). Claim-only judgment is DISABLED. If evidence retrieval fails, return SEARCH_INSUFFICIENT.

v2_frozen_results.root_cause: V2 judged claims without performing the actual search -> evidence -> claim mapping -> 102 -> 103 pipeline. Final adjudicator received claim-only + generic model knowledge.

v3_changes_from_v2: Real pipeline: canonical claim -> search concept graph -> 14 search families -> patent discovery -> actual claim retrieval -> element mapping -> relationship mapping -> 102 -> closest prior art -> objective technical problem -> 103 -> COULD/WOULD -> anti-hindsight -> final adjudication
Search insufficiency explicitly distinguished from no-prior-art-found
Generator/evaluator separation enforced (distinct roles, distinct prompts, model hashes recorded)
Anti-hindsight: rationale built before solution disclosure, then compared
Ground truth per-case constructed from prosecution record (not simplistic granted/abandoned)
Rescue recognition for amended cases (not every amendment = successful rescue)
Cited-art recall preserved at >=90% after adding full loop

ground_truth_construction.rule: Case-level ground truth from prosecution record

search_insufficiency_rule: A zero-result search without adequate coverage (fewer than 8 of 14 families attempted) must NEVER become NO_RELEVANT_PRIOR_ART_FOUND. It MUST be classified as SEARCH_INSUFFICIENT.

claim_only_path_disabled.rule: The final adjudicator must NOT receive claim-only + generic model knowledge and return a patentability result.
claim_only_path_disabled.on_evidence_failure: Return SEARCH_INSUFFICIENT. Do NOT return REJECT, NOVEL, or ELITE.
claim_only_path_disabled.enforcement: Final adjudicator input MUST include retrieved_evidence_summary. Empty evidence -> SEARCH_INSUFFICIENT regardless of claim quality.

generator_evaluator_separation.requirement: Distinct computational roles. At minimum: different prompt + different context + different evidence path. Preferred: different models.
generator_evaluator_separation.record: Every model name and prompt hash recorded per role per case.

novelty_102_rules.single_reference_rule: 102 succeeds only when ONE reference discloses ALL required limitations + required arrangement.
novelty_102_rules.element_mapping: Map L1, L2, ..., Ln for every relevant patent.
novelty_102_rules.inherency_rule: If inherency claimed, require NECESSITY_REQUIRED evidence (not merely possible).

obviousness_103_rules.closest_prior_art_selection: Most promising single-reference starting point. Normally has similar purpose/effect or closely related technical field (EPO 2026 Guidelines).
obviousness_103_rules.epo_requirement: The EPO explicitly requires the WOULD inquiry rather than merely COULD.

anti_hindsight_rules.step_1: Build inventive-step rationale BEFORE exposing the final solution.
anti_hindsight_rules.forbidden: Constructing the problem backwards from the claimed invention.

rescue_calibration.rule: For amended cases, AI must determine whether final amended claim is technically different from earlier rejected claim.
rescue_calibration.forbidden: Treating every amendment as successful rescue.

stop_rule: DO NOT run 50->5 until V3 reaches all thresholds. On failure, status remains CALIBRATION_BLOCKED.
unblock_condition: UNBLOCK_50_TO_5 only when all thresholds pass.
